sr.opis: Verzija 1.6.0 donosi moćna proširenja: Brojač karaktera sa SEO analizom i vremenom čitanja, Webtime Tracker sa dnevnim limitima produktivnosti i dev filterom, Tech Scanner sa detekcijom modernih alata (Astro, Svelte 5, Supabase, Bun, Three.js, GSAP), pametnu zaštitu slika u Dark Mode-u, kalkulator proporcija (Aspect Ratio) u Page Ruler-u, automatsko ponovno povezivanje za radio strim i oslobađanje resursa posle 150s, brzi izvoz podešavanja, novi onboarding vodič i maksimalno stabilan interfejs.

en.opis: Version 1.6.0 introduces powerful tool upgrades: Character Counter with SEO validation and reading time, Webtime Tracker with daily productivity limits and dev filter, Tech Scanner detecting modern frameworks (Astro, Svelte 5, Supabase, Bun, Three.js, GSAP), smart media preservation in Dark Mode, Aspect Ratio calculator in Page Ruler, stream auto-reconnect for Radio IN, auto-off for background resources after 150s, instant settings export, a streamlined onboarding guide, and rock-solid UI stability.

sr.opis: Novo ažuriranje donosi potpunu stabilizaciju prikaza ekstenzije u Chromium pregledačima, usavršen rendering popup prozora, glatke tranzicije između stranica i precizno beleženje istorije štoperice.

en.opis: This release stabilizes popup rendering in Chromium browsers, fixes window transparency issues, ensures smooth page transitions, and corrects stopwatch history timestamps.

sr.opis: Ovo ažuriranje donosi integraciju sa Kick.com platformom. Štoperica se sada automatski sinhronizuje sa prenosom uživo na Kick kanalu i pouzdano čuva podatke o trajanju sesije i momentima nakon završetka strima.

en.opis: This update introduces integration with the Kick.com platform. The stopwatch now automatically synchronizes with active Kick live streams and reliably saves session durations and moments when the stream goes offline.

sr.opis: Novo ažuriranje donosi kompletnu reorganizaciju strukture projekta za znatno brži i stabilniji rad ekstenzije. Otklonjene su sve uočene greške, a test suite je proširen detaljnijim testovima koji garantuju maksimalnu stabilnost. Uvedena je automatska ESLint analiza kvaliteta koda, dok su svi jezici i prevodi detaljno očišćeni i sređeni.

en.opis: This update introduces a complete reorganization of the project structure for significantly faster and more stable extension performance. All reported bugs have been resolved, and the test suite has been expanded with more thorough tests to ensure peak reliability. Automated ESLint code quality analysis was added, while all languages and translations were comprehensively reviewed and cleaned up.

sr.opis: Potpuno redizajniran veb sajt sa modernim interfejsom, poboljšanom navigacijom i detaljnim pregledom svih funkcionalnosti ekstenzije.

en.opis: A completely redesigned website featuring a modern user interface, improved navigation, and a detailed showcase of all extension functionalities.

sr.opis: Znatno smanjena potrošnja resursa, optimizovane animacije i ubrzano vreme odziva svih alata unutar ekstenzije.

en.opis: Significantly reduced resource consumption, optimized animations, and faster response times for all extension tools.

sr.opis: Dodati novi alati: Page Marker za crtanje po stranici i poboljšani Color Picker sa podrškom za više formata boja.

en.opis: Added new tools: Page Marker for freehand on-page drawing and an enhanced Color Picker with multi-format color copying.

sr.opis: Prvo zvanično izdanje All In One ekstenzije. Objedinjeno preko 15 osnovnih alata u jedan jednostavan i brz dodatak za pretraživač.

en.opis: The first official public release of the All In One extension. Combining over 15 essential utilities into one clean, fast browser addon.
